H_alpha_bracket.note: decimals are renderings of the exact rational bounds, not the certificate

method: every bound certified by an integer comparison: a/b < log_3 2 iff 3^a < 2^b; -log_2(p/q) >= c/d iff p^d * 2^c <= q^d
statement: G = {q : liminf s_L/L = alpha} contains the Besicovitch-Eggleston level set {q : lim s_L/L = alpha}, whose Hausdorff dimension is H(alpha); hence dim_H(G) >= H(alpha).
